headline: Three cases set for tonight moved to December 1st because of an administrative issue.
summary: An administrative issue meant the hearings could not be held as planned. The cases will be heard at the earliest available time. Officials apologized for the inconvenience.
discussion: Hearing reschedule: The meeting spent its time on moving the three cases because an administrative issue blocked tonight's hearings, and the chair apologized for the inconvenience.

decision_evidence.quote: I make that motion to reschedule these three cases to December 1st. May I have a second? Second. I vote Steve. I vote yes. Connor? Yes. Matt? Yes. Mark? Yes. The chair votes yes. So we've rescheduled this and again we apologize.

decision_titles: Moving three hearing cases to December 1st
